about.title: ABOUT ME
about.subtitle: Bridging Frontend Craftsmanship with AI Innovation
about.bio: I'm Sana Fatma, a Computer Science and Engineering undergraduate passionate about building responsive web applications and exploring AI-powered experiences. Through personal projects, academic work, and three internships, I've been developing practical skills across frontend development, backend integration, databases, and Java programming. I enjoy turning ideas into functional products while continuously improving my problem-solving skills.
about.narrationScript: Hello, and welcome! I am Sana Fatma, a Computer Science and Engineering undergraduate passionate about crafting responsive web applications and exploring AI-powered experiences. Through my academic work, five projects including AURA, and three internships across web development and Java programming, I turn creative ideas into reliable, intelligent digital products.

projects.title: AURA — Personalized AI Voice Assistant
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack Voice-Enabled Productivity Assistant
projects.description: A full-stack, voice-enabled personal assistant integrating React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and LLM APIs for natural conversational task automation.
projects.longDescription: AURA is Sana Fatma’s flagship AI exploration: a full-stack, web-based assistant built to simplify information retrieval, voice communication, notes, reminders, and daily task management into an integrated conversational experience.
features: Personalized natural language AI interaction through conversational prompting
Voice-based assistance and speech-to-text input processing
Built-in modules for notes, reminders, weather updates, and fast info retrieval
Robust REST APIs linking the frontend and AI backend using Axios
MongoDB persistent storage for user preferences and conversational records
Responsive dark interface designed with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS
plannedFeatures: Direct email and calendar workflow integrations
Smart-home device triggers via IoT webhooks
architecture: Frontend: React.js + Vite + Tailwind CSS with Web Speech recognition and synthesis
Backend: Express.js REST server handling LLM prompt grounding and tool execution
Database: MongoDB Atlas storing notes, reminders, and user state
Client-Server: Secure Axios HTTP communication with JWT session tokens

projects.title: SnapShoes — Full-Stack E-Commerce Web App
projects.subtitle: Modern Footwear Catalog & Cart Experience
projects.description: Developing the frontend of a responsive e-commerce shoe platform with comprehensive product exploration, cart management, and user authentication flows.
projects.longDescription: SnapShoes offers an interactive online shopping portal with modern filtering, interactive product showcases, wishlist saving, and streamlined checkout UI flows.
features: Dynamic product listing and detailed single-item views
Interactive shopping cart calculation and wishlist toggling
User login and account registration interface flows
Fluid responsive layout spanning mobile, tablet, and widescreen monitors
plannedFeatures: Order tracking dashboard and inventory webhook hooks
architecture: Modular React components for catalog, cart, and authentication
Local state management for cart synchronization across views
Tailwind CSS design system with custom brand color tokens

projects.title: Automated Hostel Allocation System
projects.subtitle: Fairness-Driven Academic Group Solution
projects.description: A database-driven allocation system replacing manual paper room assignments with automated constraint-based allocation logic.
projects.longDescription: Developed collaboratively at MANUU, this application automates the university hostel allotment workflow, providing a student application portal and an administrative dashboard.
features: Student application workflow with academic verification checks
Comprehensive administrative management dashboard for seat allotment
Frontend and database integration automating seat assignment
Constraint-based allocation logic designed to maintain transparency and fairness
plannedFeatures: Automated SMS notifications for selected room allocations
architecture: Frontend UI for student applications and admin status review
Relational database schema storing student criteria, room capacity, and quotas
Deterministic rule engine prioritizing allocations according to college guidelines

projects.title: Intelligent Task Management System
projects.subtitle: Modular To-Do & Productivity Application
projects.description: A streamlined task management web application with dynamic priority sorting, real-time DOM updates, and browser local storage persistence.
projects.longDescription: Built with pure vanilla JavaScript to demonstrate strong core DOM manipulation and modular programming without heavy framework overhead.
features: Dynamic task prioritization (Urgent, High, Normal)
Instant real-time UI updates with zero page reloads
Persistent state stored securely in browser LocalStorage
Modular, maintainable code architecture with decoupled modules
plannedFeatures: Custom task category tags and deadline notifications
architecture: Modular JS pattern separating Data Store, UI Renderer, and Event Listeners
LocalStorage synchronization hook on every create, edit, or delete action

projects.title: User Interaction-Based Music Player
projects.subtitle: Audio Interface & Spotify Clone
projects.description: An interactive web music player featuring a custom seek bar, playlist controls, and real-time audio playback feedback.
projects.longDescription: Engineered to study ergonomic user interaction patterns and audio DOM events, implementing smooth scrub bars, volume controls, and track queues.
features: Custom interactive seek bar with smooth scrubbing and time stamps
Dynamic playlist management and track queueing
Real-time audio feedback, playing states, and volume controls
Responsive navigation and playback controls for mobile devices
plannedFeatures: Audio visualizer canvas frequencies and lyric synchronization
architecture: HTML5 Audio API event listeners (timeupdate, loadedmetadata, ended)
CSS transition timeline with dynamic width calculations
